subs.text: Warning. The Warden approaches. This is it, Pilot. Everything we trained for.
Remember the briefing.
The Warden.
STOP! Stop right there! Do you have ANY idea how long it takes to grow a scout?!
That is not the voice from the briefing.
Wait. Wait, wait, wait. Your gun is cold. Why is your gun cold?!
The last cold gun was zero one two one. Oh. Oh, no. You're the next number.
And your gun is FULL. I can hear it humming from here.
You carried a Writ the whole way and you never spent it.
I am the Warden! I keep these lanes! And I am SO TIRED of saying that!
Proceed with the engagement, Pilot.
Statements by the Warden are not covered by your contract.
That was close, and close is billable. Thank you for your proximity.
My POD! Do you have ANY idea how long it takes to grow a pod?!
Pilot, your weapon shows no activity during a contracted engagement.
This has been escalated.
Recall authorization requested. Please hold. Your call is important to us.
You dodged everything. Everything! And you never fired back. Not once.
Pilot zero one two two, non-performance confirmed. Recall in three. Two.
NO! Not this one! I'm cutting your leash. Hold still!
